title: Simple and Strong
author: Mark M.
desc: Upper/Lower program with an emphasis on conpound lifts and building foundational strength for more advanced programs.

ex.note: Do 3-4 light warmup sets. Go to the point you feel you can barely squeak out 1 or 2 more reps. Rest 2-3 mins.
Your legs should be cooked after the squats so this is extra for the hamstrings. Lift to the point you can only do 1 rep. Rest 3-5 mins.
Go to absolute failure. Rest 2 mins.
Go to absolute failure on every set. Get a deep. Stretch on every rep, this is key.
Each rep is 1 second. Increase weight once you can complete every set for the maximum repetitions.
Start with feet on ground, build up to raising feet off the ground. Each set should be taken to complete failure.
Make sure to touch your chest at the bottom of each rep. Lift within 1 rep of failure. Rest 2-3 mins. Increase weight when you can do every set at the recommended reps.
Same rules/instructions as regular bench but make sure you go deeper on each rep to get a good stretch. Also, on an adjustable bench only go one peg above flat.
Take each set to complete failure. Its easy for traps to dominate this exercise so make sure to lift your arms to the point just under when your traps activate. Rest 1 min after each set

Swap this for the lat pulldown or assisted pullup if you cant use your bodyweight. Use an overhand grip just outside of shoulder width. Bring your chest to the bar. Rest 2-3 mins. Last set to failure.
Allow arms to become fully straight after every rep. Lift to 1-2 reps before failure. Take final set to complete failure. Rest 2mins.
Take first 3 sets to within 1 rep of failure. Control the weight slowly on the way down. Rest 2 mins. Take final set to complete failure.
Use either straight bar or whatever attachment you prefer. Control the weight on the way up. Take each set to within 1 rep of failure. Rest 90 secs after each set. Take last set to failure.
Take your time to warmup. Use a weight that is challenging for 5 but not so difficult you cant complete all 5 sets. Add 5-10ibs a week. Rest 3 mins
Control weight on way down and explode on your way up. Rest 2-3 mins. Get within 2 reps of failure.
Take each set to failure. Rest 2 mins.
Go to complete failure. Rest 1 min.
1 second is one rep. Go extra heavy on this day. Rest 2 mins.
Take each set to complete failure rest 1 min to 90 secs.
Feel free to do the seated variant of this exercise. Rest 2 mins.
Squeeze your chest very hard and slowly bring the weight back at the end of each rep. Rest 2 mins. Take final set to failure.
Same rules as first day.
Use lat pulldown machine or assisted variant if you cant do your body weight. Last set to complete failure.
Control the weight for the entire rep. Rest 2 mins. Take last set to failure.
Lower weight BEHIND head, not on top of it. Start very light and control each rep until you get the hang of it. Last set to failure. Rest 2 mins.
Bring adjustable bench about 2-3 pegs below the upright position. Control each and every rep as much as possible. Rest 2 mins. Take last set to failure.
